assertions.assertion: Explains that by default unmatched requests (and requests with the /t prefix but no match) return 404
assertions.rationale: States /t/unknown prefix with no matching space returns 404, and other unmatched requests also 404 unless FallbackToDefault.

assertions.assertion: Warns FallbackToDefault should only be enabled when serving unmatched host/path from the default space is an intentional part of the isolation model
assertions.rationale: Says acceptable only if falling back to the default space is an intentional isolation decision.

assertions.assertion: States a strict 404 is safer for multi-tenant deployments
assertions.rationale: Recommends keeping strict 404 and explains it is safer and keeps isolation easy to reason about.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the default space uses data pool 0
assertions.rationale: States fallback serves the default space (data pool 0).
